text_block_list.text: On a day off, on the way home after an outing with Symboli Rudolf...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The more enjoyable the time, the quicker it passes.
It really makes you realize that time flies like an arrow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Even so, having fully enjoyed our day off, all that was left was to brace ourselves for tomorrow—

Right then, Symboli Rudolf casually
glanced over toward the greengrocer's.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Maybe tomorrow I'll pack
some meat-stuffed bell peppers...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Could you wait for a moment?
I'd like to buy ingredients for tomorrow's bento.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, are you sure?
Then I shall gratefully accept your offer."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for keeping me company, Trainer.
Thanks to you, I'll be able to make a nutritious bento tomorrow too.
choice_data_list: Do you make your own bento every day?
Do you make a bento every day?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"That's generally correct. As a member of Tracen Academy,
I pay close attention to diet, the foundation of physical development."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course, the flawless delicacies of the cafeteria are prepared to aid in that endeavor, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even during lunch break, I do not wish to close
the student council room, as it serves as a consultation desk for students.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I try as much as possible to bring a lunchbox
and eat it in the student council room.
choice_data_list: I'd love to see your bento!
It must be tough to make that every day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha! You certainly find interest in the strangest things. I can't imagine there's anything particularly entertaining about it, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it feels awkward just to show it off.
If you'd like, shall I make some for you too?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it; you have taken good care of me.
Consider this an expression of my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, cooking for just one person is surprisingly
inefficient from an ingredient-consumption standpoint.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I quite often end up handing over extras
I've cooked to Brian and Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "However, since they speak so highly of it, I'll give you a heads-up beforehand..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My lunchbox is rather brown, you know?
—Hehe.
Later on, Symboli Rudolf shared some of her brown boxed lunch with me, and it tasted very wholesome and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I won't say it's never a hassle.
However, I find the benefits far outweigh that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I have a schedule packed with 'making boxed lunches'—
being mindful of this gives me a stronger push to get out of bed."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So you're fighting off the temptation of slumber
with a sense of duty and sheer appetite, I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――Haha, as expected of you, Trainer-kun.
You couldn't be sharper.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And so, as you can see, I have trouble waking up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have taken measures so that it causes no hindrance,
but its intrinsic nature is something I cannot change.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Don't go spreading this around, got it?
This is top-secret intel that only those with the rank of
Student Council Vice President or higher are permitted to know.

Saying so, Symboli Rudolf offered
a slightly mischievous smile.
